description: This Java class implements the service for reading and validating the mapping between application users and clients in the Fineract platform. It interacts with the database via JdbcTemplate and checks user-client associations.

classes.name: AppuserClientMapperReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the service interface for mapping self-service users to clients, with methods to check if a mapping exists and to validate a user's associated clients.

methods.name: isClientMappedToUser
methods.description: Checks if a specific client is mapped to a given user.

methods.name: validateAppuserClientsMapping
methods.description: Validates that the authenticated user has a mapping with the provided client ID, throwing an exception if not.
